title: Exotic Elegant Moroccan Cheese Tagine
description: A winey, creamy, and low-carb-friendly Moroccan dish featuring shredded Monterey Jack cheese, perfect for a brunch mood.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the shredded cheese, olive oil, diced onion, minced garlic, grated ginger, ground cumin, smoked paprika, and chopped parsley.
In a large tagine or Dutch oven, combine the cheese mixture, chicken broth, and white wine.
Add the ferment and stir well to combine.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven with a lid and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Moroccan cheese tagine hot, garnished with additional chopped parsley if desired.
